IC.IC2: ADHD is diagnosed according to Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, fifth edition (DSM-5 criteria).
IC.IC3: Substance Use Disorder is diagnosed according to DSM-5 criteria.
IC.IC4: Qb-score 1.3 or higher on at least one of the weighted summary parameters QbActivity, QbInattention or QbImpulsivity on the QbTest.
IC.IC5: Participants are given their written informed consent to participate in the study.
